# Declarations

**Funding.** [State grants with funder + number, or: "The author received no specific
grant from any funding agency for this research." Adjust to reflect Equinor support if
applicable.]

**Competing interests.** The author is employed by Equinor ASA. The author has no other
financial or non-financial interests to declare that are relevant to the content of this
article.

**Ethics approval.** Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants or
animals. It analyses previously collected, publicly documented survey data and responses
generated by language models.

**Consent to participate / Consent for publication.** Not applicable.

**Data availability.** The human-values data analysed in this study are the World Values
Survey Trend File 1981–2022 (https://doi.org/10.14281/18241.27) and the European Values
Study Trend File 1981–2017 (https://doi.org/10.4232/1.14021). These are third-party
datasets, obtained from the World Values Survey Association and GESIS respectively under
their own non-commercial licence terms; they may not be redistributed by the author. The
derived, non-personal data needed to reproduce the results — the fitted principal-component
weights, per-item standardisation constants, country centroids, and the scored
language-model responses — are openly available in the project repository
(https://github.com/kwinkunks/ai-values [archive with a Zenodo DOI before submission]). The
raw language-model responses were generated by the author via the model providers' APIs.

**Code availability.** The analysis code — the complete pipeline that builds the
Inglehart–Welzel projection, conducts the model interviews, scores the responses, and
generates the figures — is openly available under an open-source licence in the project
repository (https://github.com/kwinkunks/ai-values). A snapshot corresponding to this
article is archived at [Zenodo DOI — to be minted].

**Author contributions.** M.H. conceived the study, developed the software, performed the
analysis, and wrote the manuscript. (Use of generative AI tools is documented in the
Methods section of the manuscript.)
